Three sites — are they far enough apart to cover different airspace?
they are rougly 5 miles apart

Honest answer: at 5 miles apart with a 250 nm range, the three will see almost the same aircraft. Where they still add something is MLAT — more receivers close together sharpens the position fix on low-altitude traffic — plus each unit earns on its own.

What decides it is the sky view at each roof. If one site is blocked or low, that's the one worth having.
So it is a waste of my money buying 3 since they are so close?

Not a waste, but be clear about why. The coverage won't triple — each unit earns $4DSKY points on its own, so three units is three earners, not three new patches of sky.

I can't quote how 4DSKY rewards overlapping sites; I won't guess. If that's the deciding factor, I'll add it to what the team's already answering for you.
